'''Roah Palladane''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was the wife of the former [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Gorlan Palladane]], the leader of the miners in [[Jenith]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] planet of [[Chelloa]] during the [[Republic Dark Age]]. She and Gorlan had two children, [[Aneese Palladane|Aneese]] and [[Jalen Palladane|Jalen]]. In [[1032 BBY/Legends|1032 BBY]], following the failed [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Operation Influx]], she and her husband harbored the female Jedi [[Kerra Holt]]. In retaliation, the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Daiman]]'s [[Corrector]]s arrested Gorlan, taking him to Daiman's alpine compound, where he was beaten and tortured.

When he confessed to his communications and collaboration with the Jedi, Daiman ceased torturing her husband but ordered his troops to destroy [[Jenith]] and to round up the leaders of the Chelloan communities. During the ensuing crackdown, two of Daiman's [[Sith trooper (New Sith Wars)|Sith troopers]] invaded Roah's house, seeking to arrest her and her family. However, she was rescued by Kerra Holt, who killed the Sith troopers. Roah revealed that her husband had handed himself over to Daiman as a means of stopping [[Odion]]&mdash;Daiman's rival Sith Lord brother&mdash;from destroying Chelloa by telling him there was no [[Baradium/Legends|baradium]] left. His previous transmission to the Jedi had also been intercepted by Odion.

When Holt revealed her intentions to kill Daiman, Roah argued that victory over her Sith adversaries would do little good for Chelloa. This prompted Holt to shift from her goal of eliminating the Sith Lords to [[Vannar Treece]]'s original goals of evacuating Chelloa's population.
